pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/page.tsx:4 The /kit route renders static specimens and token read-backs from source.json. A grep of app/(studio)/kit for mutex, inflight/in-flight, idempot, singleflight and semaphore found nothing. Every busy/pending prop it passes is a literal false/null or inert, and the only 'lock' hits are a CSS animation name and a glyph name, so the route has no operation that can be invoked twice and nothing to guard.
